title: Pilot Uptick Technical Brief — sprint notes (WIP)
content:
Slide 1 — One-line purpose
  • Goal: give SEs a 3–5 slide technical stamp to accelerate pilot decisions for teams moving from POC to reserved/dedicated.
  • Audience: platform architects, infra leads, ML engineers (fast-read).
  • Outcome: clear asks for pilot (SLOs, traffic profile, dataset size, security needs), a simple cost delta estimate, and canary/rollback checklist.

Slide 2 — Why this exists (problem framing)
  • SEs report a long handoff between demo -> pilot -> commit. Common hangups: mismatch on latency SLOs, unexpected token costs, unclear fallback behavior.
  • We need a concise technical brief they can drop into a customer call or send after scoping. No more 10–page playbooks for first pass.
  • Quick note: this is intentionally prescriptive, not exhaustive. The aim is to reduce friction and set measurable pass/fail criteria for 30d pilots.

Slide 3 — Minimal pilot acceptance criteria (suggested)
  • Latency target: P50 < 120ms for interactive flows; P95 < 500ms. call out 99th for high-concurrency features.
  • Throughput baseline: expected tps during peak (e.g., 40 reqs/s for customer X) and burst allowance.
  • Cost guardrails: weekly token budget, expected tokens/session estimate, and fallback model cost cap.
  • Data controls: retention window, KMS required?, IP allowlist for private deployments.
  • Quality gate: pass set of 20 regression prompts (link to eval set).

Slide 4 — Quick cost delta worksheet (engineer-friendly)
  • Inputs we ask SE to capture: avg tokens/request, requests/day, expected concurrency, target model (e.g., llama-3-16b-q4).
  • Simple calc: monthly_tokens = tokens/request * requests/day * 30. unit_cost = tokens_to_cost_lookup(model). monthly_cost = monthly_tokens * unit_cost.
  • Rapid example (fill-in): avg tokens 450, 5k requests/day -> monthly tokens ~ 67.5M -> hosted baseline $X, dedicated estimate $Y (show how to compare).
  • TODO: link to Optimize recommendation API (INF-5512) for per-workload quantization suggestions.

Slide 5 — Canary & fallback checklist (operational)
  • Canary plan: 5–10% traffic to dedicated/reserved or to a higher-cost variant; scripted rollback to hosted API on error rate delta > 2x baseline or latency breach > 200ms for > 3min.
  • Health checks: token-level cost spikes, model-churn anomalies, KV-cache miss rate. where to view in console: per-route tracing -> tokens/time.
  • Preflight: traffic replay for representative 1k requests, run regression eval, set alert thresholds in Console.

Slide 6 — Ask from SE to Customer (copyable)
  • "To get this pilot live we need a short checklist from you: 1) expected peak TPS and typical session token counts, 2) list of endpoints/features that will call the model, 3) compliance/KMS constraints, 4) a 20-case prompt set for regression checks."
  • Use-case tailoring: if customer needs PII redaction or HIPAA, escalate to Private deployment track — include 4-week deployment estimate.

Slide 7 — Field-facing script + common objections
  • Objection: "Dedicated is more expensive" -> reply: show cost-per-1000-requests both with and without caching; highlight predictability and throughput guarantees.
  • Objection: "Latency requirements are unpredictable" -> reply: propose a staged canary with autoscale floor and fallthrough to hosted. show example SLA config.
  • Quick snippet for Slack/Email: short template and attachments (CSV for tokens).

Slide 8 — Quick risks & mitigations (for AE + SE alignment)
  • Risk: unrepresentative test prompts -> mitigation: mandatory 20-case prompt set + synthetic traffic to cover tails.
  • Risk: token cost blowouts -> mitigation: cost alert + cap + immediate fallback.
  • Risk: network egress / compliance -> mitigation: route via Private with KMS + compliance precheck.

Slide 9 — Next steps / execution plan (two-week sprint)
  • Week 0–1: collect pilot acceptance inputs, set up canary config, run replay tests. owner: SE.
  • Week 2: run live canary, evaluate metrics, decision meeting (go/no-go). owner: Solutions Eng + Customer.
  • Deliverable: one-page pilot report with pass/fail on the acceptance criteria and recommended next-step (reserve/dedicated, rollout plan, or iterate on prompts).

Slide 10 — Notes to self / open questions
  • Which Optimize APIs are safe to call from field bundle? (blocked on INF-5512).
  • Need a small spreadsheet template for quick cost calc — ask Product Marketing to make one.
  • Should we include an abbreviated security checklist for GDPR vs HIPAA customers? propose two checklists.
  • Slack: #pilot-bookings for logistics, #se-tech for deep-dive questions.

Appendix (one-pager attachments we plan to include)
  • regression_prompt_set.csv (20 rows), pilot-cost-calculator.csv, canary-run-template.md, console_alert_preset.json (example).

—— END WIP — thoughts: keep this under 5 slides when printed, but include appendix. Need one-liner TL;DR card for AE that summarizes ask and one clear CTA.

Linked references inside doc:
  • JIRA INF-4321: SE pilot friction epic (priority: high)
  • PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/987 — initial canary rollout script (ops)
  • Confluence: Infr/Inference-Pilot-Checklist-2024 (living checklist)
